narrative: What was done. Tripleseat exposes no line items through its API, so every May event's invoice document was pulled and parsed. Each line follows the BEO's room header (KAMPER'S, Kampers Rooftop Lounge, Bar Rotunda, Conservatory), a line that names Kamper's or Bar Rotunda goes to that outlet regardless, and standalone rooftop and Rotunda events stay 100% with their outlet. Service charge and admin fee come from each invoice's BILLING block and follow each outlet's share of base. Sales tax and gratuity are excluded throughout. Le Suprême and HIROKI-SAN private dining rows are their own book and are excluded.

Anthology's May is $448,894 net, $368,527 before service charge and admin fee. Kamper's event revenue is $107,612, of which $30,230 is standalone rooftop events (three wedding cocktail hours booked as their own events, Roth Capital, The City Institute) and the rest is its share of the weddings it hosted a cocktail hour for. Bar Rotunda carries $10,572: Yappy Hour, the Marzonie reception, Buzz Solutions, and the cocktail hour of the Jacques & Kazoleas wedding. The May Toast Sales Summaries for Anthology Events and Kamper's were not provided, so this page has no POS tie-out; send them and the Toast columns fill in.

Kamper's takes more than 20% of a shared wedding. It carries the canapés, its $1,000/hour reception fee and the cocktail hour of the five-hour bar package. Across the eight May weddings that shared a room with Kamper's the share runs 20–23%, averaging 21.9%. Jacques & Kazoleas ran its cocktail hour at Bar Rotunda instead and splits 12% that way. Where the cocktail hour was booked as its own event (Lake, Malewicz, Yarosh) Kamper's share is carried in the standalone line instead.

BEO fixes at source. Lowery (5/02), Miller (5/29) and Pierson (5/30) bill a Kamper's cocktail hour but leave the canapé block unlabelled, the same omission Toast confirmed on Hannigan and Joseph; the cocktail-hour rule moves those canapés to Kamper's here. Roth Capital (5/12) and Buzz Solutions (5/13) carry "Corporate Events" as their area on the invoice although they ran on the rooftop and at Bar Rotunda. Rachel's Network Day 1 (5/04) lists Kampers Rooftop Bar among its rooms with no Kamper's lines at all; it stays with Anthology until Toast says otherwise.
